body:
For whatever it's worth (Not sure if this would be grounds for giving PR approval) I built this branch locally and ran the 2D and 3D physics test projects we have in the [demo repository](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-demo-projects).

I ran the functional and performance tests. I didn't compare performance numbers against 4.7, but in terms of functionality I'm not seeing any regressions from this PR. Two of the 2D performance tests are crashing when trying to use concave polygons, but I ran it again in 4.7 and it's crashing in the same way so it's not a regression from this PR. And there's a good chance that demo may just need to be updated. Also saw weird stuff in a couple of the 2D performance tests and I'm not sure if any of that was intentional or not, but again the same thing happens in 4.7 so it's not a regression.
